objective.title: local-pullback for actual initial metric existence
objective.statement: Core assumption addressed: universal Hamilton input existence. Prove actual chart Euclidean pullbacks symmetric, positive on their coordinate domain, and smooth as bilinear bundle sections there. Subsequent proof: SmoothInitialMetricExistence.exists_initial_metric uses these as constructed local sections in convex partition-of-unity gluing; no metric or sphere premise may be used.

stop_conditions: Pass only with the exact frozen targets and all scoped checks.
If blocked preserve failed output, exact resisting Lean type and strongest compiled partial; no unfinished committed proof.
No target weakening, supplied metrics/recognition or extra assumptions, root editing, full build, acceptance/merge or service changes.
